content.text: Pronunciation First Name: "yax-ul" Last Name: "lend-eh-borg" Who is Yaxel Lendeborg? • Productive, versatile, and modern frontcourt big • Strong feel for the game, rebounding motor and playmaking ability • Mature and intelligent decision-maker • Team-oriented player and leader • Consistent two-way impact player • Wins rebounding battles through positioning • Began playing organized
